evidence.observation: Reboiler reads 433-438 °C and creeps steadily upward, physically implausible while the whole column sits at ~63-70 °C; indicates a failed/drifting reboiler thermocouple
Column profile flat and stable (~70 °C top-to-bottom section, 63 °C condenser), consistent with steady total-reflux-like operation
Reflux 0.1-0.2 L/h and distillate 0.2-0.8 L/h with ratio ~6.4-7.8, noisy near instrument resolution but stable

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature check (or heater duty/pressure reading) to confirm T701 is a sensor fault rather than real, plus a distillate composition (GC) measurement.
